description: Manually-demonstrated points around the microwave door's real swing path, captured 2026-09-09 on rchi-cpu-5 (Pachirisu assembly) after the door was opened to ~100deg via the corrected 35cm-radius arc. The simple single-hinge circular-arc model doesn't capture the door's true motion (confirmed non-trivial by hand); these points are for fitting/interpolating the real path instead of the naive arc formula, following the same approach noted for the Pachirisu rig's door mechanism.

original.note: where the arc waypoint sequence left off (last commanded/reached arc step before gripper release)

straighten.note: position barely moved from 'down' -- this step is mostly an ORIENTATION change (gripper re-leveled), not a translation
